'''Ras Frostwhisper''' is the [[Scourge]] [[Lich]] overseer of everything that happens in [[Scholomance]], he watches and teaches all those who rise to the position of 'Dark Master'.

Ras Frostwhisper was once a human from [[Strom]], who turned himself over to the [[Lich King]] when the [[Scourge]] invaded.  Upon the ground in [[Stratholme]], within the Slaughterhouse, Ras Frostwhisper took a dagger to his own neck and cut from one side to the other-- all the time with a smile upon his face.  His corpse fell onto [[Menethil's Gift]] and it is there that the [[Lich King]], [[Ner'zhul]] raised his fallen corpse as a [[Lich]].
